mapper.select: select `subject`, count(`subject`) as count from cr_report_score where `status` != 4 GROUP BY `subject`;
select `status`, count(`status`) as count from cr_report_score where `status` in (1, 2, 3) GROUP BY `status`;
select `user_id`, `avatar_url` as logo, `user_name`, ROUND(sum(`score`),2) as sum_score, row_number() over (order by sum_score desc) as rank from cr_report_score where status = 2 group by user_id
select `user_id`, `user_name`, `subject`, ROUND(sum(`score`),2) as subject_score from cr_report_score where status = 2 group by user_id, subject
